description: Read a policy's saved historical configuration by revision ID from list_policy_revisions, with secrets replaced by {"redacted": true}. Returns the revision's policy version, providerVersion when recorded, save time and recorded audit actor. These describe saved configuration, never proof that a device applied it or that a person manually made the change. Read-only: creates no proposal and restores nothing. Use get_policy_document for the current configuration. A large result comes in parts: notShown lists paths to read separately, and nextFromIndex continues the same path. path is a JSON Pointer with numeric array indexes; omit it for all fields including apps. The current policy group is excluded because it is not historical configuration.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

fromIndex.description: When a result carries nextFromIndex, pass it here for the rest. Default 0.

path.description: Optional JSON Pointer into the historical configuration, as in notShown. Default: the whole document (empty path). Arrays use numeric indexes, e.g. /apps/0/managedConfigurations.

policyId.description: The policy's path name - the unique identifier returned by list_policies as "pathName".

revision.description: The saved revision ID from list_policy_revisions, for this policy.

name: get_policy_revision_document
title: Get a saved policy revision
